using System;
using Etl.Core.Abstractions;
using LoadReferenceData.Csv;
using LoadReferenceData.Mapping;
using LoadReferenceData.Model;
using Xunit;

namespace LoadReferenceData.Tests;

public class DesignationTransformTests
{
    [Fact]
    public void Map_ComputesExpectedOutput_ForARepresentativeRow()
    {
        var row = new DesignationCsvRow
        {
            DesignationID = 7,
            DesignationCode = "Sample",
            Title = "Sample",
            JobLevel = 7,
            Band = "Sample",
        };
        var ctx = new RowContext(RowNumber: 1, LoadedAtUtc: new DateTime(2020, 6, 15, 12, 0, 0, DateTimeKind.Utc), SourceName: "DesignationTransform");

        var result = new DesignationTransform().Map(row, ctx);

        Assert.Equal(7, result.DesignationID);
        Assert.Equal("Sample", result.DesignationCode);
        Assert.Equal("Sample", result.Title);
        Assert.Equal(7, result.JobLevel);
        Assert.Equal("Sample", result.Band);
        // DesignationKey <- (DT_WSTR,25)(UPPER(DesignationCode) + "-" + (DT_WSTR,10)JobLevel)
        Assert.Equal("SAMPLE-7", result.DesignationKey);
        // LoadedAtUtc <- GETUTCDATE()
        Assert.Equal(new DateTime(2020, 6, 15, 12, 0, 0, DateTimeKind.Utc), result.LoadedAtUtc);
    }
}
